$comment: Machine-readable sidecar for the Salesmessage brand; mirrors StyleGuide.txt. Colors, fonts, logo and icons are the Figma One-Pagers file values (examples/figma-sms-credit-guide, imported 2026-10-13), except cta, which Figma does not define. Lighter shades (borders, pill tints) are derived in CSS with color-mix().
name: Salesmessage
voice: Clear, confident and friendly; written for busy sales and support teams.
Lead with the customer outcome, then the feature that delivers it.
Short sentences, active voice, no jargon; numbers beat adjectives.
rules: Page hero headlines use Product Sans Bold (falls back to Inter Bold) in ink #121517, with the last 1-3 words in Salesmsg Blue #0180f4. Section headings use Inter Bold; body copy uses Inter Regular in ink #121517.
Salesmsg Blue #0180f4 is the accent for values, table headers and highlights; reserve Green #13cb6e for a single call-to-action button.
Gray #667085 is only for footers and small meta text. Callouts use navy #023359 text with a blue info icon on a #f0f8ff panel.

Light-blue radial hero band (white to #c2e3ff) with the logo, date, a pill-shaped topic label, headline and subtitle; soft #f0f8ff panels and striped rows with rounded corners; no divider rules between sections; generous white space.
Footer on every page: logo, website / phone, social icons and page number in blue.
